Hi Maya / Rafael —

Thanks for the patience. Confirming details for our latest SOC 2 Type II: the report covers the period 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 (tests performed throughout that 12-month window).

Implications for your specific asks:
- Point-in-time testing: any tests performed on 2025-01-15 fall squarely within our report window and are therefore covered by the Type II attestations.

Please note we do not backdate testing; for new features released after the audit window (e.g., if a feature was released on or after 2025-10-01) we can provide process evidence and post-period controls attestations, but those would be treated separately from the report itself.

We may ask for a short checklist from GreenGrid showing which tests they need the letter to support (e.g., deletion test on 2025-01-15).

Turnaround: draft to you within 48 business hours after we receive confirmation of the desired end-date (2025-12-31) and any specific call-outs.
